about: Public-notice channels per operator or agency: pages, sites, feeds, lists and accounts through which the public is told of sewage discharges, by law, permit or voluntarily. Read by pipeline/ingest/notification_pages.py (schema and validator there; test tests/test_notice_channels.py).

channels.name: Ada Township
channels.legal_basis: MCL 324.3112a(3): "Each time a discharge to surface waters occurs under subsection (1), the person responsible for the sewer system shall test the affected waters for E. coli to assess the risk to the public health", with the results to the county health departments and the department (up to 10 tests; the health department may waive it)
channels.note: No web form: Ada Township: E. coli tests of the affected waters after each discharge to surface waters, with the results sent to the county health departments and EGLE; the law does not require their publication. No web channel found: the results stay with the health departments and EGLE. (research/mi/report.md §2.1)

channels.name: Ada Township
channels.legal_basis: MCL 324.3112a(1): "the person responsible for the sewer system shall immediately, but not more than 24 hours after the discharge begins, notify the department; local health departments ...; a daily newspaper of general circulation in the county or counties in which a municipality notified pursuant to subsection (4) is located; and a daily newspaper of general circulation in the county in which the discharge occurred or is occurring"
channels.note: No web form: Ada Township: notice of each discharge to the local health departments within 24 hours of its start; the law does not require the departments to publish it. No web channel found. (research/mi/report.md §2.1)

channels.name: Ada Township

channels.note: No web form: Ada Township: notice of each discharge to a daily newspaper of general circulation in the county where it occurred (and in the counties of downstream municipalities that asked to be told) within 24 hours of its start. Printed only; EGLE's posting of the same notice on its list is the web record. (research/mi/report.md §2.1)

channels.agency: Michigan Department of Environment, Great Lakes, and Energy
channels.name: Michigan EGLE (MiEnviro CSO/SSO List)
channels.legal_basis: MCL 324.3112a(2): "Upon being notified of a discharge under subsection (1), the department shall promptly post the notification on its website."
channels.note: EGLE's public list of sewage discharge reports (CSO, SSO, retention treatment basin and other discharges) with start, end, volume, permit, outfall and receiving water; it covers every operator in Michigan, public or private, because each must notify EGLE (MCL 324.3112a(1)) and EGLE must post the notice. GLWA's CSO notification plan names it as GLWA's 4-hour public notice. The list gives no coordinates and no posting time, and its JSON service is undocumented and carries no licence statement. No e-mail alert for overflows exists. (research/mi/report.md §2.2)
